subsystem: UIKitCore.framework - Target Content Offset Resolution, Delegate Arbitration & Custom Snapping

closed_form_landing_equation.derivation: Definite integral of continuous exponential decay v(t) = v_0 * e^(-lambda * t) from t = 0 to infinity, where lambda = -1000 * ln(d) and C_d = 1 / lambda.

pointer_mutation_protocol.semantics: Caller initializes *targetContentOffset with proposed ballistic landing coordinate s_clamped. Delegate can mutate targetContentOffset->x and/or targetContentOffset->y in place.
pointer_mutation_protocol.readback_verification: Upon return from delegate invocation, UIKit checks if *targetContentOffset != s_clamped.

cases.action: Proceed with standard exponential ballistic deceleration animation using initial release velocity and active deceleration rate d.

cases.adaptation_mechanism: Dynamic deceleration curve adaptation or target-directed spring settling.

effective_deceleration_recomputation.description: Adjusts effective friction so exponential decay lands exactly at delegate-specified target position.

cases.spring_handover_condition: If displacement delta |s_target - s_projected| > 150.0 pt or d_prime falls outside physical range [0.85, 0.9995], UIKit switches from ballistic deceleration to target-directed _UIScrollViewSpringAnimation or _UIScrollViewScrollAnimation.

cases.adaptation_mechanism: Immediate transition to boundary bounce recovery spring (_UIScrollViewSpringAnimation) targeting nearest boundary limit with transferred release velocity.

custom_detent_array.representation: Sorted array of double coordinates: [p_0, p_1, p_2, ..., p_{N-1}], where p_0 < p_1 < ... < p_{N-1}

bias_threshold.description: Fling velocity threshold differentiating intentional directional snap from neutral nearest-neighbor settlement.

directional_search_modes.algorithm: Locate smallest detent p_i strictly greater than current offset s_0. If projected offset s_proj > s_0, select nearest detent to s_proj subject to p_i >= p_{current + 1}.
Locate largest detent p_i strictly less than current offset s_0. If projected offset s_proj < s_0, select nearest detent to s_proj subject to p_i <= p_{current - 1}.
Pure Euclidean distance minimization: p* = argmin_{p_i} |s_0 - p_i|.

multi_detent_clamping.maximum_detents_skipped: Configurable (default unlimited in collection views, clamped to 1 in standard paging).
multi_detent_clamping.clamping_formula: index_target = clamp(index_projected, index_current - max_skip, index_current + max_skip)

flow_layout_implementation.behavior: Queries layout attributes for elements in target rect, snaps to cell leading edge or center based on sectionInset and minimumLineSpacing.

decompiled_routines.role: Calculates default proposed content offset clamped to bounds.
Layout-level offset resolution allowing item and section snapping.
Custom snapping behavior executing directional nearest-neighbor detent search.
